mapper.select: SELECT product_id, category_id, code, name, name_en, price, discount_price, description, size_info, tags, is_new, is_sold_out, is_active, view_count, sort_order, stock_quantity, stock_alert_threshold, last_stock_update_at, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE product_id = #{id}

SELECT product_id, category_id, code, name, name_en, price, discount_price, description, size_info, tags, is_new, is_sold_out, is_active, view_count, sort_order, stock_quantity, stock_alert_threshold, last_stock_update_at, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( category_id, code, name, name_en, price, discount_price, description, size_info, tags, is_new, is_sold_out, is_active, view_count, sort_order, stock_quantity, stock_alert_threshold, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{nameEn}, #{price}, #{discountPrice}, #{description}, #{sizeInfo}, #{tags}, #{isNew}, #{isSoldOut}, #{isActive}, #{viewCount}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{stockQuantity}, 0), COALESCE(#{stockAlertThreshold}, 10), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock_quantity = #{quantity}, last_stock_update_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, category_id, code, name, name_en, price, discount_price, description, size_info, tags, is_new, is_sold_out, is_active, view_count, sort_order, stock_quantity, stock_alert_threshold, last_stock_update_at, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE is_active = true AND stock_quantity <= stock_alert_threshold ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC, name ASC
